summary: Gargoyles need 75 Slayer, 80 combat and Priest in Peril, and live only in the Slayer Tower: on the top floor, and in the basement, where they can only be killed on task. They cannot be killed normally: finish each one at low health with a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer, or buy Gargoyle smasher (120 points) to do it automatically with a rock hammer in your inventory. They are weak to crush, have -2 flat armour, and Protect from Melee blocks all of their damage. The basement is the usual choice because more of them spawn in a smaller area. Killing them on task can drop the brittle key that opens the Grotesque Guardians on the roof.
requiredItems: Rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer
usefulItems: Slayer ring (teleport to the Slayer Tower)
Ring of wealth (picks up their frequent coin drops)
alternatives: Grotesque Guardians (Dusk and Dawn, on the roof)

summary: Rockslugs need 20 Slayer and are assigned by Mazchna and Mortimer. Use a bag of salt on one at 4 Hitpoints or less to finish it; at 5 or more the salt is wasted. The Slug salter unlock (10 points) does this automatically with bags of salt in your inventory, and a brine sabre kills them without salt. Their drops are poor (low-level ores and seeds, rarely mystic gloves (light)).
requiredItems: Bag of salt or Brine sabre

summary: Mutated zygomites need 57 Slayer, 60 combat and Lost City, and are assigned by Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve and Duradel. They hide as fungi in Zanaris until you pick them, and can only be finished with a fungicide spray, which needs refilling with fungicide every ten kills. Ancient zygomites on Fossil Island or in the Stalker Den also count, unless Konar sends you to Zanaris; if she sends you to Fossil Island, only the ancient ones count. Their attacks are magic-based, so dragonhide armour helps, and Protect from Melee is the prayer to use because their melee attacks are more accurate.
usefulItems: Reagent pouch (ancient zygomites always drop mort myre fungus)

summary: The Grotesque Guardians, Dusk and Dawn, are the gargoyle Slayer boss on the Slayer Tower roof (75 Slayer), fought in a solo instance on a gargoyle or Grotesque Guardians task. The roof is unlocked once, permanently, with a brittle key dropped by gargoyles on task. Bring a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer to finish them. Dawn flies, so only halberds reach her in melee, and Dusk is immune to magic and ranged; melee or a melee/ranged hybrid is usual. Both together count as one kill, or two with Double Trouble.
requiredItems: Rock hammer, rock thrownhammer or granite hammer
